title: Accept the selected debug integration matrix with a Windows waiver
changes: Accept DBG2-27 for the documented selected matrix after the user explicitly waived native Windows execution; preserve the distinction between acceptance and a test result.
validation: Reviewed retained Wine selection, controller, cancellation, error and moved-folder records; Linux event-console, three-channel parity, live watch and physical navigation/selector receipts; cheat and recipe replay records. Selected cases and protected-input/normal-close evidence are linked in the integration matrix. Synthetic divergence and earlier timeouts remain negative outcomes.
limitations: Native Windows was not run: the user requested that criterion be considered accepted. The physical cancel case allowed repeated presses; other devices, dialogs and combinations remain unverified. DBG2-20 remains suspended and its outstanding criteria are not covered by this acceptance.
